## Data Structure Requirements {.smaller}

```{.r}
# Example of properly formatted data
sample_data <- data.frame(
  COUNTY_ID = c("01", "01", "01", "01"),
  DISTRICT_ID = c("001", "001", "001", "001"),
  SCHOOL_ID = c("0001", "0001", "0001", "0001"),
  COUNTY_NAME = c("Alameda", "Alameda", "Alameda", "Alameda"),
  DISTRICT_NAME = c("Oakland Unified", "Oakland Unified", "Oakland Unified", "Oakland Unified"),
  SCHOOL_NAME = c("Lincoln Elementary", "Lincoln Elementary", "Lincoln Elementary", "Lincoln Elementary"),
  YEAR = c(2023, 2023, 2023, 2023),
  SUBJECT = c("ELA", "MATH", "ELA", "MATH"),
  DISAGGREGATED_GROUP = c("All_Students", "All_Students", "Hispanic", "Hispanic"),
  PARTICIPATION_RATE = c(94.5, 93.2, 89.1, 88.7),
  CHRONIC_ABSENT_RATE = c(18.3, 18.3, 22.1, 22.1),
  STUDENTS_ENROLLED = c(245, 245, 156, 156)
)
```
- **Multi-Year Data**: Each row represents a unique combination of school-year-subject-student group.

- **Subject Coverage**: Each school-year-student group combination should have separate rows for ELA and MATH.

- **Student Groups**: Include "All_Students" as well as disaggregated groups.

---

## bueller_report()

```r
# Install the package (if not already installed)
devtools::install_github("erwx/bueller")

# Load the package
library(bueller)

# Generate your report
bueller_report(
  data = your_prepared_data,
  output_dir = "engagement_reports/"
)
```

- Simple function call - just point to your data and specify output location

- Future versions may include a helper function to automatically set up directory structure

## Toy Data

- **Source:** California Department of Education public data files
- **Years:** 2018-19 through 2023-24 (No 2019-20. Thanks, COVID)
- **Chronic Absenteeism Files:** Absenteeism rates
- **CAASPP Assessment Files:** Participation rates
- School-level data, *NOT* student-level data
- Data available as far back as 2016-17

---

## Internal Functions {.smaller}

**`calc_district_metrics()`**

- Aggregates school-level data to district level
- Calculates enrollment-weighted averages 
- Creates district-year observations

**`calc_school_variation()`**

- Calculates min/max/standard deviation across schools within districts
- Identifies districts where few schools drive overall problems

**`calc_participation_trends()`** & **`calc_absenteeism_trends()`**

- Year-to-year trends
- Participation thresholds (95%?)
- Absenteeism thresholds (30%?)
